Class CreateAccountPanel

java.lang.Object
CustomGuiComponents.CreateAccountPanel
public class CreateAccountPanel extends Object

Title: CreateAccountPanel Class.

Description: A shared panel used by both the first admin setup and new account creation flows. Validates username and password before creating the account and navigating to the account setup page. Features real-time password validation feedback as the user types, including matching check against the confirm field.

Version:
1.00 Initial implementation, 1.01 2026-06-08 Added error label for UI feedback (Kyle Kim), 1.02 2026-06-08 Added real-time password validation listener (Kyle Kim), 1.03 2026-06-08 Fixed real-time validation to watch both password fields (Kyle Kim), 1.04 2026-06-08 Added guard flag to prevent listener cross-firing (Kyle Kim)
Author:
James Suchovic (Team 3) - Designed and implemented account setup UI, navigation flow, layout structure, and functionality, Kyle Kim (Team 3) - Added on-screen error label and real-time password validation

  • Method Details

    • buildCreateAccountPanel

      public static javafx.scene.layout.VBox buildCreateAccountPanel(javafx.stage.Stage theStage, String inviteCode)

      Method: buildCreateAccountPanel()

      Description: Builds and returns a VBox panel for account creation. Used by both the first admin setup page and the new account creation page. If inviteCode is null, the account is created as Admin. Otherwise the role is determined by the invitation code. Features real-time password strength and match feedback as the user types in either password field. A guard flag prevents the two listeners from triggering each other in a feedback loop.

      Parameters:
      theStage - the current JavaFX stage
      inviteCode - the invitation code, or null if this is the first admin setup
      Returns:
      a VBox containing the account creation panel
